activities.title: AMAZING HOMES
activities.questionsInstruction: Complete the sentences. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage for each answer.

questions.text: The two people who live in the transparent house love it, but it wouldn't _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn B: 'It wouldn't suit everyone but the couple who live there love the feeling...'

questions.text: The designer of the smallest house hopes to _____ to the lack of houses all over the world.
questions.explanation: Đoạn D: 'Van Bo Le-Mentzel... built it to draw attention to the world housing shortage.'

questions.text: People who stay in igloos sometimes protect themselves from the cold by making use of _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn E: 'We used reindeer skins to keep warm.'

questions.text: People who have _____ would find a holiday in a treehouse ideal.
questions.explanation: Đoạn F: 'It was the perfect place to get away from our busy lives.'

activities.title: HOME FROM HOME
activities.questionsInstruction: Read the passage and complete the sentences below. Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage for each answer.

questions.text: The writer's mother often cooks _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: 'my mum's roast chicken in the oven'

questions.text: She thought the visit to Germany would make her feel _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: 'spend three weeks, homesick and sad'

questions.text: Brigitte came to pick up the girl with _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: 'Behind her stood her parents'

questions.text: The Schmitt family's pets' names are _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4: 'They had two cats, Ping and Pong'

questions.text: From her bedroom the girl could see _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4: 'we looked out onto a forest'

questions.text: The girl and her family tried hard to make Brigitte _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 5: 'to help Brigitte feel at home with us'

activities.title: FOOD CULTURE SHOCK
activities.questionsInstruction: Complete these sentences using a word from the text.

questions.text: In China, if you refuse food, the host will usually _____ the offer.
questions.explanation: Đoạn C: 'because the person will definitely repeat the offer.'

questions.text: For Alfredo, food plays an important role in a person's _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn B: 'Food is part of your identity'

questions.text: In India, you should not use your _____ when eating.
questions.explanation: Đoạn A: 'You use your fingertips, never the palm of your hand'

questions.text: In some countries, eating meat represents _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn D: 'meat equates to prosperity'

questions.text: In many places in _____ there is no difference between foods eaten for breakfast and dinner.
questions.explanation: Đoạn E: 'when I travelled in Asia, I realised that in many places, there is no difference...'

activities.title: OUR FRIENDS AND PROTECTORS
activities.questionsInstruction: Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO/THREE WORDS from the passage.

questions.text: A pod of dolphins saved the life of a man called _____ while he was videoing them.
questions.explanation: Đoạn B: Wildlife filmmaker Hardy Jones was filming a group of dolphins...

questions.text: The man was a famous _____ for the protection of dolphins.
questions.explanation: Đoạn B: 'In fact, Jones was a well-known campaigner...'

questions.text: Orcas were trying to catch and hurt a group of _____ who were travelling from one place to another.
questions.explanation: Đoạn E: 'protecting migrating grey whales from attacks by orcas'

questions.text: The migrating whales were helped by _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn E: 'filmed a group of humpback whales who were protecting...'

questions.text: The whole incident lasted more than _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn E: 'over a period of at least seven hours'

questions.text: Because of the icy waters she was unable to _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn E: 'couldn't move her legs due to the freezing temperatures'

questions.text: One of the whales saved her life by taking hold of her _____ and giving her a push upwards.
questions.explanation: Đoạn E: 'Mila gripped Yang Yun's leg in her mouth'

activities.title: THE MODERN ZOO
activities.questionsInstruction: Complete the notes below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage for each answer.

questions.text: Before the 1990s, zoos existed mainly for _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn A: 'the main purpose of zoos was for entertainment'

questions.text: The first zoo to focus on protecting animals was started by _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn A: 'In 1959, famous wildlife expert Gerald Durrell opened...'

questions.text: Since the 1990s a number of zoos aim to breed threatened animals and return them to their _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn B: 'reintroduce endangered species into their natural habitats'

questions.text: But first the animals have to learn how to survive in the _____.
questions.explanation: Đoạn B: 'teaches orangutans how to live in the wild'

questions.text: Zoos offer animals _____ by making it challenging for them to find their food...
questions.explanation: Đoạn C: 'Zoos try to provide enrichment for the animals'

questions.text: _____ enable the public to view zoo animals from their homes.
questions.explanation: Đoạn D: 'webcams in some enclosures so visitors can keep up...'

activities.title: UNUSUAL SPORTS
activities.questionsInstruction: Complete the summary using the list of words A-L below.

questions.text: If you've had enough of ordinary sports, you can try a number of (1) _____ new sports.
questions.explanation: 1 = K (strange - lạ lùng)

questions.text: Some of these were created when people (2) _____ two well-known sports.
questions.explanation: 2 = G (mixed - kết hợp)

questions.text: Sometimes they added a (3) _____ from the part of the world where they lived.
questions.explanation: 3 = D (feature - đặc điểm/yếu tố)

questions.text: Buzkashi, a sport from Afghanistan, is played on (4) _____ and uses a dead goat...
questions.explanation: 4 = E (horses - ngựa)

questions.text: Chess boxing is a sport where you need to (5) _____ rapidly from one activity to another.
questions.explanation: 5 = B (change - hoán đổi, chuyển đổi)

questions.text: You need to be (6) _____ and also fit.
questions.explanation: 6 = C (clever - thông minh/trí óc)
